properties.description: Where an organisation blocks MCP, init writes what a VS Code agent needs to reach reflow2 through the terminal, under .github/ for the team to commit: the instructions file (the text the binary serves as get_instructions section `vscode-terminal-route`), the hook file, a skill stub per served skill and a prompt per slash command. It writes no MCP config. Each Markdown file carries a mark with a hash of the rest of it, so update refreshes a file reflow2 wrote and nobody touched, and keeps an edited or foreign one, with or without the git-ignored install receipt. The hook file is reflow2's by the receipt or by matching byte for byte. The route is chosen by name: `all` and an unanswered install mean the MCP harnesses, and an MCP harness's install is unchanged byte for byte. Answers limitation 11 of the VS Code field report.
properties.name: `reflow2 init --harness vscode-cli` installs VS Code's terminal route as committed files, and `reflow2 update` refreshes reflow2's own and nothing else
